name: Frontier with Microsoft design tokens
font: "Segoe Sans Text","Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",Carlito,Arial,sans-serif
font_display: "Segoe Sans Display","Segoe UI Variable Display","Segoe UI",Carlito,Arial,sans-serif

primary.note: Subscribe only, header and any Subscribe form

hub.note: Anything that opens The Hub, the storyboard, Dynamics 365 skills or Industries

buttons.rule: Solid colors only, never gradients. White text at 4.5:1 or better in every state (default, hover, pressed, focus). Hover deepens the color, lifts 1px and adds a soft glow in the button's own color; pressed is deeper again with no lift; keyboard focus adds a white outline plus a ring in the button's color. 150ms transition, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

hero.mobile: under 760 px: photo full width at 0.45 opacity

microsoft_logo.placement: upper left of the top bar

msStrip.placement: full width, bottom edge of the sub header (or bottom of row 1 on pages with no sub header), equal quarters left to right
